```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)

data("rest_inspec")

set.seed(1)

inspec_df = 
  rest_inspec |> 
  filter(
    boro != "0",
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"),
    inspection_date > as.Date("2010-01-01"),
    !is.na(score),
    score >= 0) |> 
  mutate(
    boro = factor(boro),
    grade = factor(grade, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
    inspection_date = as.Date(inspection_date),
    cuisine = str_trunc(cuisine_description, 20))

inspec_sample = sample_n(inspec_df, 5000)
```

Column {data-width=450}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Inspection scores by borough

```{r}
inspec_sample |> 
  mutate(boro = fct_reorder(boro, score)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    y = ~score, 
    color = ~boro, 
    type = "box", 
    colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Borough"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection score"))
```

Column {data-width=550}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Ten most frequently inspected cuisine types

```{r}
inspec_df |> 
  count(cuisine) |> 
  slice_max(n, n = 10) |> 
  mutate(cuisine = fct_reorder(cuisine, n)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~cuisine, 
    y = ~n, 
    color = ~cuisine,
    type = "bar", 
    colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of inspections"),
    showlegend = FALSE)
```

### Median inspection score over time, by borough
```{r}
inspec_df |> 
  mutate(quarter = floor_date(inspection_date, "quarter")) |> 
  group_by(boro, quarter) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_score = mean(score),
    n_inspections = n(),
    .groups = "drop") |> 
  filter(
    n_inspections >= 100,
    quarter < as.Date("2019-10-01")) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~quarter, 
    y = ~mean_score, 
    color = ~boro,
    type = "scatter", 
    mode = "lines",
    colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Inspection date"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Mean inspection score"))
```
